backend/main.mo: Main actor for the Hindu devotional app backend, defining data types (Festival, Mantra, Aarti, CommunityPost, etc.) and state maps for user profiles, temples, community posts, jap counters, kathayen, bhajans, and more, with admin initialization and migration support.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that upgrades CommunityPost records from an old schema (no media fields) to a new schema by adding null image, video, and fileAttachment fields.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report confirming high-confidence implementation of the community post media attachment feature (image/video/file upload with preview) across Community.tsx, CommunityPostCard.tsx, and useQueries.ts.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-sentence summaries of all frontend source files, describing each component's purpose and notable implementation details.
frontend/.env.example: Example environment file documenting the optional Google Gemini API key configuration, noting it is stored client-side and that image generation uses the keyless Pollinations.ai service.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark themes, including background, foreground, card, sidebar, and chart color tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point that mounts the React app into a root div and loads the main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that configures TanStack Router with all application routes (Home, Panchang, Jap, Aarti, Community, Kathayen, Mandir, AIGuru, Admin, Profile, Mantras, Bhajans, Chalisa, VratDashboard), wrapped in QueryClientProvider, ThemeProvider, and Toaster.
frontend/src/components/AartiCard.tsx: Card component for displaying an aarti entry with a flame icon, truncated Hindi text, optional deity tag, and navigation to the aarti detail page on click.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Shared app shell providing a sticky saffron/gold gradient header with Om logo, vrat mode indicator, profile link, a conditional NotificationBanner, main content area, and BottomNav.
frontend/src/components/BottomNav.tsx: Renders a fixed bottom navigation bar with 9 Hindi-labeled nav items (Home, Panchang, Jap, etc.) using TanStack Router links, highlighting the active route with gold styling and animations.
frontend/src/components/ChatMessage.tsx: Displays a single chat message bubble (user or AI) with text, timestamp, and TTS controls (play/pause/stop) using the useSpeechNarration hook, with Hindi language detection for appropriate icons.
frontend/src/components/ChatTypingIndica: Shows an animated three-dot typing indicator bubble with an AI guru avatar, used to indicate the AI is composing a response.
frontend/src/components/CommunityPostCar: Renders a community post card supporting text, image, video, and file attachments, with a like button and relative Hindi timestamp display.
frontend/src/components/DailyDharmaQuote: Displays a styled daily dharma quote card with Hindi and English text, author attribution, and a loading skeleton, falling back to a hardcoded Bhagavad Gita quote if data is unavailable.
frontend/src/components/EkadashiReminder: Shows a dismissible banner reminding users of upcoming Ekadashi dates (within 7 days) with a contextual Hindi message, persisting dismissal state in sessionStorage.
frontend/src/components/FestivalCountdow: Displays a festival countdown card showing days remaining until a given festival date, with a share button that uses the Web Share API or clipboard fallback.
frontend/src/components/FloatingLotus.ts: Renders decorative floating lotus petal images as a fixed full-screen background layer with CSS keyframe animations at varied positions and timings.
frontend/src/components/GoldenHalo.tsx: A wrapper component that renders a pulsing golden radial glow halo around its children, with configurable size via numeric or named presets.
frontend/src/components/KathaCard.tsx: Renders a clickable card for a Hindu katha (story) displaying its title, a preview of the Hindi text, category label, deity emoji, and tags, navigating to the katha detail page on click.
frontend/src/components/Loader.tsx: Displays a spinning mandala image with an Om symbol overlay as a loading indicator, with optional size and text props.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: A button that handles Internet Identity login and logout, showing localized Hindi labels and clearing the React Query cache on logout.
frontend/src/components/LotusBloomOverla: A full-screen animated overlay that appears when 108 japa counts are completed, showing a lotus image, petal burst particles, and a celebratory message.
frontend/src/components/MalaRing.tsx: Renders an animated canvas-based mala (prayer bead ring) with 108 beads, filling beads based on the count prop and displaying a breathing Om symbol in the center.
frontend/src/components/NotificationBann: Displays a styled in-app notification banner with a type-specific icon, title, body, dismiss button, and an auto-dismissing progress bar over 10 seconds.
Shows a brief burst animation of three Om symbols radiating outward from the center, auto-hiding after 700ms.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: A modal dialog prompting new users to enter their name to create a profile, submitting it via the useSetUserProfile mutation with a default mantra selection.
frontend/src/components/SacredRipple.tsx: Renders up to four concentric ripple ring animations centered on the component whenever the trigger prop changes, used as a tap feedback effect.
frontend/src/components/ShlokaCard.tsx: A React card component that displays a Sanskrit shloka with its Hindi and English meanings, including copy-to-clipboard and native share functionality with decorative styling.
frontend/src/components/VratModeDashboar: A dashboard component for fasting (vrat) mode that displays Brahma Muhurat times, countdown timers to upcoming Ekadashi and Shivratri dates, and vrat-related task checklists.
frontend/src/components/VratModeToggle.t: A toggle UI component that enables or disables Vrat Mode, visually switching between active (amber/gold) and inactive styles using a Switch control.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A custom React hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, supporting both anonymous and authenticated (Internet Identity) access with access control initialization.
frontend/src/hooks/useAIChat.ts: A custom React hook managing AI chat state, including sending messages, building conversation history, persisting chat to localStorage, and handling loading/error/retry states.
frontend/src/hooks/useDailyNotifications: A custom React hook that schedules seven daily browser notifications (or in-app banners) at fixed times for Nam Jap, Aarti, and Vrat reminders, with enable/disable and permission management.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and hook using DFINITY's AuthClient, exposing login, logout, identity state, and login status to child components via a React context provider.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend interactions including user profile, jap counter, dharma quotes, and festivals, using TanStack Query's useQuery and useMutation with actor-based ICP canister calls.
frontend/src/hooks/useSpeechNarration.ts: Custom React hook that wraps the Web Speech API to provide text-to-speech narration with play/pause/stop controls, automatic voice selection for Hindi (Devanagari) and English content.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Poppins and Tiro Devanagari Hindi fonts, defines a devotional saffron/gold OKLCH color theme with light/dark variants, and declares custom CSS animations like float, glow-pulse, and lotus-bloom.
frontend/src/lib/aiEngine.ts: AI engine module that sends chat messages to Pollinations.ai (free, no API key) using a Hindu spiritual guide system prompt, with multiple fallback strategies and retry logic for generating responses.
frontend/src/lib/aiGuruData.ts: Static data module providing zodiac rashi definitions and templated daily horoscope prediction strings in Hindi for love and career aspects, used to generate per-rashi daily forecasts.
frontend/src/lib/kathaData.ts: Contains static data for Hindu religious stories (Kathas) including full Hindi texts for Ramayan, Mahabharat, and other Puranik tales, typed as the backend's Katha interface.
frontend/src/lib/panchangEngine.ts: Client-side astronomical calculation engine using Jean Meeus algorithms to compute Hindu calendar (Panchang) data such as sun/moon longitudes, tithis, and nakshatras for a central India location.
frontend/src/lib/staticData.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces and static data arrays for Shlokas and Aartis (Ganesh, Shiv, Vishnu, etc.) with Hindi and English text content.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React application entry point that mounts the app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers.
frontend/src/pages/Aarti.tsx: List page displaying all available Aartis as navigable cards, pulling data from staticData and linking to individual Aarti detail pages.
frontend/src/pages/AartiDetail.tsx: Detail page for a single Aarti that supports Hindi/English toggle, copy, share, and text-to-speech narration via the useSpeechNarration hook.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanel.tsx: Admin panel page that allows authenticated admins to manage approvals, community posts, dharma quotes, vrats, and bhajans via tabbed UI; also provides a claim-admin form for first-time admin setup using a token.
frontend/src/pages/AIGuru.tsx: Chat UI page for an AI spiritual guide ('Divya Guru') that displays conversation messages, suggested prompts, and a text input, using the useAIChat hook for message handling.
frontend/src/pages/Bhajans.tsx: Bhajans page displaying a list of static Hindu devotional songs with expandable lyrics and text-to-speech playback, supplemented by dynamically fetched bhajans from the backend.
frontend/src/pages/Chalisa.tsx: Displays the full Hanuman Chalisa text with options to copy, share, and listen via text-to-speech narration.
frontend/src/pages/Community.tsx: Community page where authenticated users can create posts with text, deity tags, and media attachments (image/video/file), and view approved community posts fetched from the backend.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Simple dashboard page that greets the logged-in user by name and provides navigation guidance to other app sections.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Home page showing a hero banner, daily panchang strip, vrat mode indicator, Ekadashi reminder, dharma quote, and a grid of category navigation links to app features.
frontend/src/pages/Jap.tsx: Jap page implementing a mantra chanting counter with a mala ring UI, supporting 9 mantra options, tracking daily/lifetime/streak stats via backend queries, and triggering a lotus bloom animation every 108 counts.
frontend/src/pages/KathaDetail.tsx: Detail view for a single katha (sacred story), displaying Hindi/English text with copy, share, and text-to-speech controls, and a dynamic banner image based on the story's deity/category.
frontend/src/pages/Kathayen.tsx: Kathayen listing page that merges static and backend katha data, providing search and category filter tabs (all, puranik, vrat, krishna) with a hero banner and card-based layout.
frontend/src/pages/Mandir.tsx: Mandir finder page that links to Google Maps for nearby Hindu temples and includes a sacred portal link with a golden ripple animation triggered on click.
frontend/src/pages/Mantras.tsx: Mantras page displaying a static list of 8 Hindu mantras as expandable cards with Sanskrit, Hindi, and English text, plus text-to-speech playback support.
frontend/src/pages/Panchang.tsx: React page displaying Hindu Panchang (almanac) data including Tithi, Nakshatra, Vara, Yoga, Karana, Paksha, sunrise/sunset, and auspicious periods, with date navigation controls.
frontend/src/pages/Profile.tsx: React page showing a user's devotional profile including lifetime jap stats, mala count, admin badge, vrat mode toggle, and links to settings, fetching data via custom query hooks.
frontend/src/pages/VratDashboard.tsx: React page providing a vrat (Hindu fasting) dashboard with countdown timers to upcoming festival dates, a sattvic food guide, and a daily vrat checklist.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module for extracting, persisting, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage fallback support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining a devotional color palette (saffron, gold, maroon, cream) and semantic design tokens mapped to CSS custom properties for the app's theme.
project_state.json: Project state manifest tracking existing features, pending fix requests (admin bootstrap logic, community media uploads), known issues, and architectural metadata for the BairagiBeats app.
